{{Quote|Attention, ''The Emperor's Vision''. Your transmitted credentials have been confirmed. You will follow the transmitted heading and dock at Imperial station HM7-R, where your physical credentials will be examined.|Communication from HM7-R to ''The Emperor's Vision''|<ref name="OSG" />}}
'''HM7-R''', nicknamed '''the Hammer''', was a refitted [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[FireStar-class Orbital Defense Station|''FireStar''-class Orbital Defense Station]] located in the [[Stylar Nebula/Legends|Stylar Nebula]], in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="OSG" />
